literal_meaning: চরণ (feet) + সেবা (service); service of the feet
similar_in_english: Worship the ground someone walks on
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি তার গুরুর চরণসেবা করে দিনরাত ভক্তি নিয়ে থাকেন।
ভক্তরা মন্দিরে গিয়ে দেবতার চরণসেবা করেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He devotes himself to the charan seva of his guru day and night.
Devotees go to the temple to perform charan seva to the deity.
history: This idiom draws from ancient Indian traditions of guru-shishya parampara, where disciples serve the feet of their spiritual teachers as a symbol of humility and devotion.
note: Commonly used in Hindu and Bengali cultural contexts to denote utmost reverence.
